queries: 2026 AGI demonstrated verified human level general intelligence October

sources_considered.why: Read in full. Discusses prospective AGI-to-ASI pathways but does not establish the antecedent or cognitive necessity.
Read as a guide to disputed claims and primary evaluations. Its synthesis was not substituted for the benchmark operator's evidence.
Primary independent evaluation addresses a prominent candidate and explicitly distinguishes benchmark progress from demonstrated AGI.

evidence_items.explanation: The independent evaluator reports substantial progress but explicitly declines to establish AGI. This leaves the antecedent unverified; it does not prove that AGI is absent everywhere or settle the necessity of cognitive insights.

unresolved_gaps: No admitted evidence verifies the AGI antecedent under the stated reading.
No complete development record establishes whether the specified human-cognition insights were indispensable.
A successful system containing human-inspired components would not prove a universal necessity claim.
